notes.title: Fall In Love Visual Novel Festival
notes.content: [p]In Rottenroots, you're not only fighting your way through the Sundown - you're also fighting your way into your beloved's heart. Which end of this love triangle will be your choice? Your secret lover James, or the ambitious Audrey? Your choice reflects Salem's internal conflict: Is he ready to risk it all to be happy, or will he bow down to his family's expectations?[/p][p]Every decision has consequences. Every kiss could be the last. And sometimes love means being willing to die for each other.[/p][p]Will you fight for your love?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312745/822f1fd1ef23f00b4c058d74970ed3b156483538.png"][/img][/p][p]Make impossible choices and prepare to get your heart broken![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3177730/Rottenroots/"][/dynamiclink]If romance is your jam, make sure to check out other games from the festival as well![/p][p]PS: If you're on Twitch, keep your eyes peeled - you might catch us in some streams![/p]

notes.title: Rottenroots Episode 1 went live!
notes.content: [p]Our Sundown Demo left some of you confused. And rightfully so, because we threw you right into the middle of the action![/p][p]With our new demo, which we titled Episode 1 (because that's what is in the grand scheme of things), you get the opportunity to learn more about Salem, and familiarize yourself with his world before the merciless Sundown begins.[/p][p]Feel Salem's sense of duty for his parents, experience his bond with his rebellious sister, and dream about a future where only love matters. Then, prepare for heartbreak.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312745/df228ea992ffbf1edac338e33646bc2f9b5eb04f.png"][/img][/p][p]New features:[/p][list][*][p]More sprites[/p][/*][*][p]More decisions[/p][/*][*][p]More roleplaying aspects[/p][/*][/list][p]We will probably publish some more updates in the next days with some minor tweaks! Also, we're very open to feedback and suggestions.[/p][p]This is named Episode 1, but don't be afraid: the full game will come out at once, we won't continue releasing single episodes![/p][p]Have fun with the new demo![/p][p](Please be aware: if you have an older savegame that you wish to continue, please do so before updating your game! We made some big structural changes, so any old savegames might be corrupt now)[/p]

notes.title: Rottenroots Against Living Miserably
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Time to talk about a serious topic today.[/p][p]Unfortunately, every year many young people decide to end their lives - way too many. In fact, in the UK, 125 people die from it every week, making it the biggest killer of men under 50.[/p][p]As people, we empathize with them and they people they leave behind.[/p][p]And as a dev team, we think we can maybe add just a tiny bit of help against that.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312745/b9be1c0d35cb451c9dbf336651a97edc59d32a01.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our game's protagonist finds himself in harsh circumstances where it's easy to lose hope and give up, but he keeps fighting for a better future. With a character like that constantly on our minds, we feel like we need to work on a better future for our real world as well. And also, you know what? Sometimes a game, a good story, a different world is all you need to escape dark thoughts for a while.[/p][p]That's why we decided to support CALM, the Campaign Against Living Miserably. They provide a free suicide prevention helpline, and are really making a difference for people who are struggling. Besides that, they also offer helpful resources on [url="https://www.thecalmzone.net/"]their website[/url].[/p][p]And this is how Steam comes into play as well. [/p][p]Running from 8–15 September, to mark World Suicide Prevention Day, we’re proud to take part in Games Against Living Miserably 2025 - the event on Steam that celebrates how games can help us unwind, connect, and escape. It’s presented by Curve Games and the suicide prevention charity, Campaign Against Living Miserably.[/p][p]At the moment, all we have is a free demo - so no proceeds directly from the game that we could donate. However, we're still going to make a donation (based on the assumed sales we would have made during the event). [/p][p]If you also want to support their cause, feel free to make a [url="https://www.thecalmzone.net/donate"]donation to them[/url] as well![/p]

notes.title: The Hungry Ghost Festival has begun!
notes.content: [h1]A spooky hello to everyone![/h1][p][/p][p]Some of you might know the Hungry Ghost Festival already. But if you don't, have a glimpse into South East Asian culture on Steam! Among other games, Rottenroots is featured to celebrate the[url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621/sale/TheHungryGhostFestival2025"] Hungry Ghost Festival[/url] and indulge in horror and spookiness for a while.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312745/4c6ca8e159479e4c25567d5332f0d714e095f97f.png"][/img][/p][p]So, take a step closer and explore Salem's world in our free demo. Will he survive a Sundown? [/p][p]And stay tuned for our full release next year, if you want to uncover the mysteries below the camp![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3177730/Rottenroots/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Have fun with the festivities and some horror vibes![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Kz5AzZVbfEc?feature=shared"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]-Your friends at Klabautermann Games [/h3]
